selected_records.title: HexaGripper: A Single-Actuator, Winch-Deployed Gripper for Autonomous Aerial Parcel Collection

article.body:
Autonomous Aerial Parcel Gripper: HexaGripper Concept Unveiled

A new concept for an autonomous aerial parcel gripper, HexaGripper, is detailed in a recent arXiv paper titled "HexaGripper: A Single-Actuator, Winch-Deployed Gripper for Autonomous Aerial Parcel Collection." However, the paper does not specify the aircraft platform, autonomy stack, sensor suite or operational domain for this concept.

No reported test results, safety figures, deployment status, fleet, or regulatory approval are provided in the paper. The title alone does not establish that the gripper has been tested in service or that a parcel-delivery operation exists. The development remains a concept at this time.
